run_bottomup_pose_demo: run bottom-up human pose estimation on an image, video, or webcam using a config and checkpoint
run_pose_inference_on_image: run bottom-up pose estimation inference on a single image file and save the visualization output
run_pose_inference_on_video: run bottom-up pose estimation on a video file frame by frame and save results as MP4
run_pose_inference_on_webcam: run real-time bottom-up pose estimation from a webcam feed and save predictions to JSON
run_pose_demo_with_heatmap: run bottom-up pose estimation with heatmap visualization enabled and a custom keypoint threshold
